propertySets.name: Pset_GeotechnicalAssemblyCommon
propertySets.definition: Properties describing the characteristics of any geotechnical model. A Status of "New" should not be associated to a IfcGeotechnicalAssembly or IfcGeotechnicalStratum, as other entities are used for earthworks and courses.

properties.name: Methodology
properties.definition: Methodology used to prepare the contents of the geotechnical assembly.

properties.name: BoreHolePurpose
properties.definition: Purpose for which the borehole, section or volumetric model was created. (EU Inspire, boreholeML)

properties.name: Status
properties.definition: Status of the element, predominately used in renovation or retrofitting projects. The status can be assigned to as "New" - element designed as new addition, "Existing" - element exists and remains, "Demolish" - element existed but is to be demolished,  "Temporary" - element will exists only temporary (like a temporary support structure).
